read.en: Lumentum fell 3.6% on Nov 12 to $624.65, trading $591.17–644.16 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($598.6) and below the 10-day ($633.5), 30-day ($833.9), 100-day ($844.1) and 200-day ($812.8); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($791.30), and RSI is 39.2.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月12日下跌 3.6%，收于 $624.65，盘中区间 $591.17–644.16，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日均线（$598.6）上方，10 日（$633.5）、30 日（$833.9）、100 日（$844.1）和 200 日均线（$812.8）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$791.30），RSI 为 39.2。

read.en: The close slipped under the $626.8 Nov 4 close and the Nov 11 low ($633.6), now resistance, while the $591.17 low held the $594.8–602.3 Jul 28–29 lows. Resistance is $626.8–633.5, then $644–651 (Nov 12 and Nov 4 highs) and $679–684. Support is $591–602.3 (5-day, Jul lows, Nov 12 low), then $570–586 and $545. A close above $633.5 would target $644–651; below $591, $570–586.
